context: Sakura interviews a small-business owner about records.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business interview; vocabulary (申請/実績/決算/免許/区別) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お店の決算は、ご自分でされますか?
lines.en: Do you do the shop's accounts yourself?
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そや、決算は自分でやっとるで。
lines.en: Yeah, I do the accounts myself.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私費と経費の区別は、難しいですか?
lines.en: Is distinguishing personal and business expenses hard?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 区別は、慣れるまで大変やったわ。
lines.en: Distinguishing them was tough until I got used to it.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 補助金の申請も、されましたか?
lines.en: Did you apply for subsidies too?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 実績を見せて、申請したで。
lines.en: I showed my track record and applied.
lines.style: enthusiastic Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 営業の免許も、要りますか?
lines.en: Do you need a business license too?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 免許を取って、堂々と商売しとるで。
lines.en: I got the license and run the business proudly.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
